SHORT_DESCRIPTION: JAVA-BALI POWER SECTOR RESTRUCTURING AND STRENGTHENING PROJECT
PROJECT_TITLE: Java-Bali Power Sector Restructuring and Strengthening Project
LONG_DESCRIPTION: The Java-Bali Power Sector Restructuring and Strengthening Project for Indonesia aims to improve the performance of the power sector on Java-Bali by: (a) supporting the State power company (PLN) to implement its financial and corporate restructuring plan, and to strengthen key elements of the Java-Bali electricity supply system, and (b) assisting the State gas company (PGN) to prepare the groundwork for restructuring its gas transmission and distribution operations. There are five components to the project. 1) The Project will support PLN's initiatives to (a) achieve greater utilization of existing generation capacity on Java-Bali, (b) improve the security of supply to the cities of Cirebon and Surabaya, and (c) debottleneck local interconnections between bulk transmission and subtransmission. 2) The Project will support PLN's initiatives to (a) provide a level of security commensurate with the existing and potential PLN and PP geothermal generation capacity evacuated through the West Java 150kV subtransmission network near Bandung, (b) improve security of supply to Surabaya, and (c) relieve multiple localized overloading and voltage problems at subtransmission level. 3) The Project will support PLN to implement a pilot rollout of the company's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) information system. 4) The Project will also support PLN's restructuring program-as well as its institutional strengthening initiatives-through technical assistance. 5) The Project will support PGN's restructuring and institutional strengthening initiatives, through technical assistance.

LONG_DESCRIPTION: Product type: LIBOR BASED LOAN.     The proposed project is perfectly aligned with ADB's Energy Sector Assessment Strategy and Roadmap, which supports investment in strategic transmission assets that connects regions or countries across seas or international boundaries to optimize power networks by reducing the overall need for reserve capacity, improving system reliability, removing transmission bottlenecks, and transmitting cheaper power from one area to the other, addressing overall regional socio-economic and environmental improvement.

Product type: LIBOR BASED LOAN. The project forms part of the governments regional economic development master plan and its long-term power development plan. The project will benefit the population in Bali by meeting future demand growth in Bali Island, thus ensuring long-term power supply security to support sustained socio-economic growth and  government plan to achieve 90% electrification by 2020.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: JAVA-BALI ELECTRICITY DISTRIBUTION PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
PROJECT_TITLE: Java-Bali Electricity Distribution Performance Improvement Project
LONG_DESCRIPTION: Product type: LIBOR BASED LOAN.     The key objectives of the project are to mainstream energy efficiency as a strategic planning option to reduce the overall cost of operating the distribution business for PLN and its customers, and deliver good quality (less voltage fluctuations and improved harmonics) and reliable (less frequent and shorter-duration interruptions) electricity. The proposed energy efficiency project will deliver good quality, reliable power with lower losses by using existing distribution resources more efficiently. The proposed project will: (i) improve overall efficiency of electricity distribution in the Java Bali grid, and (ii) promote demand side management practices (new technology and behaviors) to reduce waste by educating customers and PLN staff on these practices and providing energy-efficient equipment.
Product type: LIBOR BASED LOAN.     The Project will expand renewable energy use and thereby limit emission of greenhouse gases.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: CLIMATE PROTECTION IN CITIES - SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT
PROJECT_TITLE: Climate Protection in Cities - Solid Waste Management
LONG_DESCRIPTION: Cities are important producers of greenhouse gases and at the same time highly affected by the impact of climate change, e. g. by more frequent flooding events which lead amongst others to loss of property and a spread of diseases. Indonesia has taken up the topic of climate change and presented a strategy comprising i. a. both adaption and mitigation measures that cities can take. The present programme contributes to the implementation of this strategy. The overall objective is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from solid waste disposal through sustainable investments in solid waste management in selected cities and to improve the environmental and / or hygienic situation in Indonesian cities.  To reach this objectives, improvements in all aspects of solid waste management chain are necessary.  Besides the investments, consulting services as a support in the preparation and implementation of the measures as well as complementary training measures in order to secure the sustainability are foreseen. Energy and Environment Partnership Program (EEP) aims to increase access to sustainable renewable energy and reduce the growth rate of greenhoue gases in Indonesia. The program promotes wider use of renewable energy and cleaner technology as well as energy efficiency in the rural communities especially among poor and women. The program is especially targeting biomass for energy and is centred in two provinces Riau and Central Kalimantan. The EEP provides co-financing for projects on biomass for energy implemented by community based organisations NGO's and public and private sector. The program also provides support for capasity building in the target areas.
